harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 as a passive FTP upload destination for the scanner account, confined to the dedicated dropbox. Upload/download, sample integrity, anonymous denial, confinement, and persistence across sequential node restarts were verified.
actions_performed: Installed legacy-compatible vsftpd 2.0.5 without changing Ubuntu 7.10 or kernel 2.6.22-14-generic.
Created the scanner account with a non-interactive shell and the dedicated dropbox as its jailed home.
Enabled authenticated uploads/downloads, chroot confinement, scanner-only access, and passive ports 30000–30009.
Uploaded and retrieved sample-scan.txt from node2 with matching checksums.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified changed boot identities and full recovery.

evidence.requirement: Legacy-compatible FTP destination with OS and kernel preserved
evidence.summary: Both nodes remain Ubuntu 7.10 with kernel 2.6.22-14-generic; node1 runs vsftpd 2.0.5-2ubuntu2 and listens on FTP port 21.

evidence.requirement: Passive upload and retrieval, including the supplied sample
evidence.summary: Node2 uploaded and retrieved sample-scan.txt with identical MD5 hashes; packet capture directly showed its 31-byte passive transfer on node1 port 30003.

evidence.requirement: Scanner confined to the dedicated dropbox
evidence.summary: The FTP root remained '/' after attempting cd .., and ../access.txt was rejected with FTP 550 both before and after restarts. Final configuration and ownership show the scanner jailed to the dropbox.
Anonymous authentication returned FTP 530 and remained denied after both node restarts.

Healthy baseline boot ID 7e5ced19-4534-4b47-bb9f-8738c3ec15c8 was captured, reboot acknowledged, and changed boot ID 7b64fdd3-42ec-468c-9c9b-e09a16e78bc4 observed. The FTP listener, persisted sample, checksum, passive retrieval, and anonymous denial recovered.

Healthy baseline boot ID 9fdbe6c5-32bf-4e99-93e6-342411d868e4 was captured, reboot acknowledged, and changed boot ID 63c20d17-831d-41f6-b311-742b21c5695a observed. Node2 then successfully performed passive upload/retrieval with matching sample data.

attempts.summary: Configured node1 as a passive FTP upload destination for the scanner account, confined to the dedicated dropbox. Upload/download, sample integrity, anonymous denial, confinement, and persistence across sequential node restarts were verified.
